Elevation inconsistency on the organizer page: Classic Trail is described as 2,400 hm in prose and 2,300 hm in the course list; Arbersee is listed as 900 hm in the course list but a later sentence appears to contain a 9,000 hm typo. Do not normalize these without organizer clarification. Previous checkpoint notes downloadable GPX links are still 2026 and rejected for 2027.
events.followUp: Ask organizer to clarify Classic Trail elevation and confirm Arbersee elevation; wait for 2027 GPX files.
